title.en: Reaching before and after a juncture

statement.en: With every configuration listed, what can be had is had within as many steps as there are configurations; at a configuration with a step keeping it that is not a juncture, no step can be refuted to keep it.
statement.zh: 构形列尽时，可得者在不多于构形数之步内得之；有保之之一步而不是机之处，无一步可被驳为不保之。

laws.en: With every configuration listed, a configuration from which s can be had has it within the count of configurations.
laws.zh: 构形列尽时，可得 s 之构形在构形数之内得之。

laws.en: At a configuration with a step keeping s and which is not a juncture for s, no step can be refuted to keep s: choosing is needed only at a juncture.
laws.zh: 有保 s 之一步而非 s 之机之构形上，无一步可被驳为不保 s：择只在机上。

hypotheses.en: No axiom; a finite list of every configuration for the bound; none for the juncture law.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理；界须构形之有限全列；机之律无前提。

does_not_show.en: A bound on how long s stays obtainable along a course: on a cycle it can stay so for ever.
does_not_show.zh: 沿一行程 s 保持可得之久之界：在回环上可永远如此。

validation_scope.en: Machine-checked by the consolidated Lean 4.29.1 checker (receipt 20261121T223556.393134Z): the 2 declarations cited here have empty axiom reports; the checker verifies core purity. First built and reviewed in one session (study section 342; receipt 20261022T060905.150236Z, the bound then under two further premises); the bound from the list alone was read before landing by readers who took no part; not independently reviewed by a person.
validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器实查（回执 20261121T223556.393134Z）：本记录所引 2 项声明公理报告为空；检查器并核对核心纯净。初在一个会话中构建并审查（研究第 342 节；回执 20261022T060905.150236Z，其时界另带两个前提）；只凭列表之界在落地前经未参与的读者审读；未经人的独立审查。

correspondence.en: Reachability within the number of states (the pigeonhole bound on shortest paths).
correspondence.zh: 状态数之内之可达（最短路径之鸽笼界）。

aliases: Reaching before and after a juncture

detail.en: Its juncture; before one no step needs choosing.
Entering what returns within the count is the same bound on a determined law.
detail.zh: 在构形数之内入复返之域是确定之律上之同一界。

detail.en: States a gap its map found (entries xici-zhi-ji-qi-shen, sunzi-bing-shi, hanfei-yulao-bian-que).
detail.zh: 陈述其对应所发现之缺口（条目 xici-zhi-ji-qi-shen、sunzi-bing-shi、hanfei-yulao-bian-que）。

detail.en: Its bound on reach where a list holds every configuration has one move fewer; the bound here follows from it.
detail.zh: 其一列表容纳每个构形时之可达之界少一步；此处之界由之而得。

history.en: 22 October 2026: added (ZG), for the gap the ZH reading raised; study section 342.
history.zh: 2026年10月22日：新增（ZG），补中华思想脉络之读所提出的缺口；研究第 342 节。

history.en: 22 November 2026, board row FM (the landing owed after the law of what a list holds): the first law re-told. Branching.reach_within_listed keeps its name and conclusion and loses two premises (steps decided, s returning); it asks only a list holding every configuration, and follows from Reaching.reach_within_of_pred_le (record kept-at-the-length-of-a-list). Branching.leadsWithin_trace, used by no other proof, is deleted and leaves the law, the references and the aliases. Statement and hypotheses no longer name decided steps; the statement no longer says "again" of what can be had, since s need not return, and now says that the configuration of its second clause has a step keeping it, as the second law does; the second law is unchanged. AI-written. Former first law: "A configuration leading into s within k steps has a step and a course of fewer than k steps into s; with every configuration listed, steps decided and s returning, a configuration from which s can be had has it within the count of configurations." Bound to core run 20261121T223556.393134Z.
history.zh: 2026年11月22日，工作板条目 FM（“列表所容者之律”之后所欠的落地）：第一条规律重述。Branching.reach_within_listed 名称与结论不变，去掉两个前提（步可判定、s 复返），只须一列表容纳每个构形，由 Reaching.reach_within_of_pred_le 而得（见记录 kept-at-the-length-of-a-list）。Branching.leadsWithin_trace 不为其他证明所用，删去，从该律、引用与别名除去。陈述与前提不再提可判定之步；陈述不再说“再”得（s 不必复返），第二句现在写明该构形有保之之一步，与第二条规律一致；第二条规律不变。AI 撰写。第一条规律原文：“在 k 步内通向 s 之构形有一步及其后少于 k 步之行程入 s；构形列尽、步可判定、s 复返时，可得 s 之构形在构形数之内得之。” 绑定于核心运行 20261121T223556.393134Z。
